blocks.x: How Achala Swarm is put together: the orchestration planes, the controls and the audit export your risk team will ask about.
Structurally Achala Swarm is planes, not layers, workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.

blocks.x: Instrumented from week one, on your channels, Achala Swarm edition:

Runtime dependencies: Temporal, LangGraph, Kafka, OPA, Kubernetes, core/SaaS connectors. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Swarm follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one process to a briefing. We will show the agent fleet, the queues and the human checkpoints it would run with.
